comentarios: A flock about 9 individuals flying over canopy  of premontane forest. They were very active especially in the morning feeding  on some fruiting trees  for a period of one hour or two and then flying to other local patch of fruiting trees, in fact crossing valleys and resting, based in the information provided by local people, in the cliffs adyacent to the Cauca river (between Peque, Ituango and Sabanalarga). Where  they told me , they also nest mainly in the period between April and June. Recording distance was 15 meters.
